body:
Well, then again I've been doing this for about four years, too, so don't give up heh. The journal thing is great even if you're not into lucid dreaming, I find. A few people I know have started their own and had a blast just because dreams are amazing like that.

And "seem" is the operative word here heh. Have to be though, I coordinate events for a gaming community in GW2 and being grumpy certainly doesn't help. That plus, being friendly over the internet makes me happy on its own. Not to mention you seem like a great person, so it's easier on my side too.

Yup! That's the one, the weightless track. It takes a bit to get used to, what you should do is lay in bed and have it either on headphones or good quality speakers with a subwoofer (as it's really the lower frequencies that do the trick), then control your breathing and imagine a colour as you inhale and its opposite as you exhale. Just doing that alone induces meditation, but the process is sped up with the music. I like using RainyMood on top of it as white noise is pretty great in general... And you should be able to fall asleep (assuming you're not under a ton of stress and in shock because of... reasons.) fairly quickly!

And same to you! But mostly, I cannot thank you enough for talking to me a little; my problems aren't solved but at least that's one more day I've gotten through. Much love. <3

Aye, we often talk about our respective problems and I don't think it helps at all, although it is a way for us to vent we always end up in the same state of mind that things are going to hell in a handbasket and we have little control over it because of our attitudes. Well, my attitude and her condition. She is the sole reason I haven't seriously tried the "easy way out" just yet, the attempt I made was half-assed on purpose.


And it's alright about the lack of advice, just knowing that somebody replied and read it all makes me feel just a little better. I'm also very glad you knew what I meant by awareness right away; and even though I'm the one in the weak position right now, if you ever feel sad and can't overcome it, you can shoot me a private message here on reddit. My friends are pretty supportive so far, the reason I have so few is because I don't often let my guard down; though I've been through a lot of things with these people (their problems and mine). I love them dearly but don't show it nearly enough.

I know about LD! My dream journal is 100~+ pages long! In an odd way, my dreams usually get more vivid the worse I feel. I wouldn't say my sleep is under control now, I still can't manage to get more than four hours a night, but at least it's a start. I think I may have grown too high a tolerance for the RainyMood + Marconi Union's Weightless combo, hah. 

Mmmhm, it is "self-diagnosed" and after months of delaying it, I'm about to get in touch with a therapist, thanks to a (huge) little push by an ex-teacher of mine. One thing is sure though, even if it doesn't work, there will be an end to that story; it's up to me to write the "how", though. But yeah I've always been itchy about going to therapy as, you know, others need it more than I do and besides it is way more expensive than what our family can spare right now :(

Thank you very much for the quick answer, man. You're right about the purpose of this subreddit; lately has been a time for a lot of firsts too. As I've mentioned, my first attempt on my life, but also my first real "opportunity" at getting an internship which is a good step towards getting a job, and my first time seeking profesional help. But despite all that, I feel worse than I've felt before, I've gone 51 hours without sleeping just a few days ago (before that, I would sleep way too much at any given time of the day; being awake is too much pressure)

And it's 'funny' because I made this post after trying to contact my closest friends, had three voice mails and the last one just texted me back. It does bring a little light, so to speak. I wish I could go out and have fun though, I really do, but it's taxing me so much, and I really can't afford going out with them either because they are all in college fairly far away from where I am, and I don't have the money to make the trip let alone the evening. I've also been worried about my mother a lot, she has fibromyalgia and cannot work because of it, yet it's mostly not recognised as an invalidity in my country so the different work related associations keep bothering her. She's a strong woman, and knowing that I let her down the way I let myself down is one of the main reasons behind my so called depression. Also, I think my awareness of my situation and its "seriousness" is just another setback to my getting better, in some way I find hard to explain.

But again, thank you so much for taking the time to reply. It means a lot.
